name: Electronic Intelligence (ELINT)
title: Electronic Intelligence Mastery Quiz
hubDescription: Read radar fingerprints, separate ELINT from COMINT and ES, and trace an intercept to the EOB.
lede: Apply ELINT concepts to fictional Philippine Army classroom and field-exercise scenarios. Separate ELINT from COMINT and ES, read a radar's fingerprint and intent, and follow an intercept from detection to the Electronic Order of Battle. {total} questions across Easy, Medium, and Hard, mixing situational and objective items. Practical interception, jamming and targeting procedures are not tested.
categoryOrder: Radar Principles and the One-Way Advantage
